items.item: Move `JSON.Stream` (and anything else that needs async streams) into its own target, e.g. `JSON St
items.reason: Decided against a separate target: the trait-gated code stays in the JSON target under `#if Stream` (the ecosystem's convention, e.g. swift-storage), so JSON.Stream users only enable the trait and keep working unchanged. A separate target/product is an owner choice.

items.item: Gate the swift-async-stream package dependency behind a trait (e.g. `Stream`) that is off by defa
items.reason: Acceptance (`swift package show-dependencies` resolving no swift-async-*) not verifiable here: relies on SwiftPM pruning a package used only by a disabled trait condition.

items.item: Drop the `@_exported public import Async_Stream` from `JSON`.

api_changes: JSON.encode(_:options:) (Encodable) unchanged signature; depthExceeded now reported as EncodingError.invalidValue
JSON.Serializable.from(eventDecodingJsonBytes:) now throws on trailing content (event-grain deserializers that stop before the end of the value now fail)

New trait `Stream` (off by default); JSON.ND.stream(_:) and JSON.Parse.stream(ndjson:) exist only with it; JSON no longer re-exports Async_Stream by default (JSON.parse(collecting:), init(collecting:), Parse.collecting stay ungated)
